cards.audioText: [Your callsign is UAL921, you are from Wuhan to San Francisco, ready for taxi, call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是UAL921，你从武汉飞往旧金山，准备滑行，呼叫武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL921, from Wuhan to San Francisco, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航921，从武汉飞往旧金山，请求滑出。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point of runway 04 via F, A7, A.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，武汉地面，沿滑行道F，A7，A滑至跑道04等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 04 via F, A7 and A, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道F，A7，A滑至跑道04等待点，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, read back correct, contact Tower on 118.65.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，复诵正确，联系塔台118.65。

cards.audioText: [You are holding short of runway 04, you are ready for departure, call Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在跑道04外等待，已经准备好起飞，呼叫塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL921, holding short runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航921，跑道04外等待，准备好起飞。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Wuhan Tower, winds 060 degrees 10m/s, runway 04, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，武汉塔台，地面风060，10米/秒，跑道04，可以起飞。
【飞机通过600米爬升1500米，呼叫离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL921, airborne runway 04, passing 600m for 1500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航921，04号起飞，通过600米上升1500米。

cards.audioText: UAL921, cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb and maintain 3900m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，取消SID，直飞HFE，上升保持标压3900米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb and maintain 3900m on standard, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消SID，直飞HFE，上升保持标压3900米，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [Purser tells you a passenger has heard abnormal noises from aft cabin. You decide to level off at 2700m. Advice Departure your intention to level off due to possible problem in cabin.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务长告诉你一位乘客听到机舱尾部发出异常噪音。你决定在2700米平飞。告诉离场，由于客舱可能出现问题，你想要平飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL921, request level off at 2700m due possible problem in cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航921，由于客舱可能出现问题，请求2700米平飞。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Departure, what’s the malfunction of your aircraft?[Aircraft levels off. No one else can confirm the noise that the particular passenger heard. You check: all the instruments are indicating normally. You decide: continue the flight and request for a higher level. Call Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，离场，飞机出现什么故障了？【飞机平飞。其它人都无法确认该乘客听到的噪音。你检查发现所有仪表显示正常。你决定继续飞行，并请求更高的高度。呼叫离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL921, the aircraft normal now, continue the flight and request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航921，目前飞机正常，继续飞行，请求高高度。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, contact Control on 125.0.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到，上升保持标压4500米，联系区调125.0。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 4500m on standard, 125.0, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压4500米，125.0，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [You are cruising at 10700m, over HFE at 22, squawk 5316, call Shanghai Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在10700米巡航，过HFE时间22分，应答机5316，呼叫上海区调。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL921, maintaining 10700m, over HFE 22, squawk 5316.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，美联航921，10700米保持，HFE 22分，应答机5316。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Shanghai Control, radar contact. Proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，上海区调，雷达已识别。直飞VMB。

cards.audioText: [Strong sound from cabin. Your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly. Slow depressurization is suspected. Request immediate descent from 10700m to 3000m. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【座舱内有巨大声响。你的仪表显示座舱压力正在慢慢升高。疑似缓慢释压。请求立即从10700米下降至3000米。紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL921. There is slow depressurization in cabin, request descent from 10700m to 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，上海区调，美联航921，客舱缓慢释压，请求离开10700米下降到3000米。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger PANPAN. Turn right heading 150. Initially descend and maintain 8900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到PANPAN。右转航向150。起始下降保持8900米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900m, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向150。下降保持8900米，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, turn left heading 120. Descend and maintain 3300m.[Read back the instruction. Ask for land at the nearest suitable airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，左转航向120。下降保持3300米。【复诵该指令。请求在最近的合适机场降落。】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 3300m, request land at the nearest airport, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向120，下到3300米保持，请求在最近的机场降落，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, the closest airport is Nanjing Airport. Current visibility is marginal. I have to check if they can accommodate an aircraft of your size. Hongqiao and Pudong airport has longer runways and can definitely accommodate your aircraft. Advised your intention.[Ask for radar vector to the airport that has better visibility between Hongqiao and Pudong.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，最近的机场是南京机场。当前能见度处于临界状态。我要检查南京机场能否接收你。虹桥机场和浦东机场有更长的跑道，并且肯定可以接收你。请示意图。【请求雷达引导至能见度较高的虹桥机场或浦东机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request fly to the better visibility airport between Hongqiao and Pudong, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求飞往能见度较高的虹桥机场或浦东机场，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger, direct to HSH, expect radar vector to land at Pudong Airport. Contact Shanghai Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到，直飞HSH，雷达引导至浦东机场。联系上海进近128.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HSH, radar vector to Pudong, contact Shanghai Approach 128.35, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HSH，雷达引导至浦东机场。联系上海进近128.35，美联航921。
